name: codesense
description: CodeSense is a benchmark suite focused on measuring models' understanding and generation of source code across common developer tasks (e.g., code completion, summarization, search/ retrieval and classification). It evaluates a model's ability to produce correct, runnable code and to reason about code semantics rather than natural language fluency alone. The benchmark is intended to compare model performance on practical code-centric tasks.
reputation: A niche code-focused benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with modest community use for code-model evaluation.
